## Problem

What problem would this solve? What are you trying to do that ThunderLoad
cannot do today?

## Proposed solution

How you imagine it working. Screenshots or examples from other download
managers help.

## Alternatives

Any other approach you considered, and why it does not work for you.

## Additional context

Anything else that matters: which browsers or platforms it affects, whether
it needs a store permission, whether it touches DRM or live content
(DRM circumvention is out of scope for this project).
